notes: P2: Card (10c-spec §1-6). Sizes: poster 124x186 dp (home rows, grids), compact 116x174 (AI page), wide 176x99 (an episode card outside Continue Watching), frame 224x140 (Continue Watching).

Written for the content the LOCAL server gives the test profile 'Claude QA' (2026-10-10), not for the 02 §3.1 fixture: Home row 0 = Continue Watching (frame cards with progress: film, film, an EPISODE third, film), row 1 = the first poster row (every Home poster carries the kind tag); Browse/Shows opens on 'Reacher' and 'Silo', both NEW (added < 7 days ago — the new-tag states expire with that window; pick another fresh title then).

Not reachable without a fixture or a server flag, so declared and skipped: wide (no episode item exists outside the frame row in this library — needs the 02 §3.1 fixture: --server fixture), compact (the AI page needs an answer: --server aiMock), blur-up (--server artDelay), broken-tile (--server artFail).
The A side is ALWAYS all-js; B flips only this file's letters (C). The native card lives inside the Focusable, so the meaningful run is --impl FC.

Traces: focus.ring / focus.spring = the card gaining focus after the LAST key; .out = the element losing it. A traced multi-key path waits 900 ms before its last key, so the earlier moves' springs (≈ 500 ms) are at rest and not in the compared series.
